title: Double Consecutive Electrical Countershock for Atrial and Ventricular Fibrillation: A Narrative Critical Review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Recent strategies for refractory ventricular fibrillation (VF) and atrial fibrillation (AF) employ two consecutive, biphasic shocks with varying evidence of success. Due to their electrophysiological similarities, the strategies used for VF and AF can be collectively referred to as double consecutive electrical countershock (DCEC). This review aims to identify and synthesize outcome data on the effectiveness of DCEC across both VF and AF.

METHODS: This narrative critical review with systematic search methods was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA checklist where applicable. From 672 identified articles, 262 duplicates were removed and 410 screened; 316 articles irrelevant to the study were excluded. Of 94 sought for retrieval, 8 were unavailable and 67 failed full-text screening, leaving 19 included articles (16 VF, 3 AF). All 19 underwent risk-of-bias assessment (RoB2, ROBINS-I, or AMSTAR-2) and data extraction.

RESULTS: Full-scale randomized controlled trials (RCTs) showed low risk of bias, pilot RCTs had "some concerns," observational studies carried serious risk of bias, and meta-analyses showed "low confidence." High-quality randomized evidence showed improved primary outcomes for DCEC in both refractory VF (survival to discharge, return of spontaneous circulation, good neurological outcome) and high-BMI AF (arrhythmia termination). Non-randomized observational studies predominantly showed non-statistically significant differences.

CONCLUSIONS: DCEC shows potential to improve arrhythmia termination in refractory VF and high-BMI AF. Randomized evidence supports its efficacy, while observational findings remain neutral due to confounding. Success in high-BMI AF supports elevated BMI as a hypothetical indication for DCEC in VF.

AI.tldr: 双连续电复律（DCEC）在难治性室颤和高BMI房颤中可改善主要结局，随机证据支持其疗效，但观察性研究结果中性。
AI.motivation: 难治性室颤和房颤的复律策略证据不一，且两者电生理相似，本综述旨在系统评估双连续电复律（DCEC）在室颤和房颤中的有效性。
AI.method: 叙述性批判综述，采用系统检索方法，遵循PRISMA清单。从672篇文献中筛选，最终纳入19篇（16篇室颤，3篇房颤），进行偏倚风险评估（RoB2、ROBINS-I或AMSTAR-2）和数据提取。
AI.result: 高质量随机对照试验显示DCEC在难治性室颤（出院生存率、自主循环恢复、良好神经功能结局）和高BMI房颤（心律失常终止）中改善主要结局；非随机观察性研究多显示差异无统计学意义。
AI.conclusion: DCEC在难治性室颤和高BMI房颤中可能改善心律失常终止，随机证据支持其疗效，但观察性研究因混杂因素结果中性；高BMI房颤的成功提示高BMI可能是室颤中DCEC的假设性适应证。

summary_zh:
背景：近期针对难治性心室颤动（VF）和心房颤动（AF）的策略采用两次连续双相电击，其成功证据不一。由于两者在电生理上的相似性，用于VF和AF的策略可统称为双连续电复律（DCEC）。本综述旨在识别并综合DCEC在VF和AF中有效性的结局数据。

方法：本叙述性批判性综述采用系统检索方法，在适用情况下遵循PRISMA清单进行。从识别出的672篇文章中，去除262篇重复文献并筛选410篇；排除316篇与研究无关的文章。在需获取的94篇文献中，8篇无法获取，67篇未通过全文筛选，最终纳入19篇文章（16篇VF，3篇AF）。所有19篇均进行偏倚风险评估（RoB2、ROBINS-I或AMSTAR-2）和数据提取。

结果：全面随机对照试验（RCT）显示低偏倚风险，试点RCT存在“一些担忧”，观察性研究存在严重偏倚风险，荟萃分析显示“低可信度”。高质量随机证据显示DCEC在难治性VF（出院存活率、自主循环恢复、良好神经功能结局）和高BMI AF（心律失常终止）中均改善主要结局。非随机观察性研究主要显示无统计学显著差异。

结论：DCEC显示出改善难治性VF和高BMI AF中心律失常终止的潜力。随机证据支持其疗效，而观察性研究结果因混杂因素仍为中性。高BMI AF中的成功支持将升高的BMI作为VF中DCEC的假设性适应证。

title: Blood and urinary NT-proBNP: atrial fibrillation-associated patterns and cardiac dysfunction in acute chest pain.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: NT-proBNP is the gold-standard biomarker for diagnosing and monitoring congestive heart failure (CHF); however, its role in detecting atrial fibrillation (AFib) is gaining attention. This study assessed the influence of aberrant cardiac rhythms on plasma NT-proBNP (pNT) considering urinary NT-proBNP (uNT) as a noninvasive alternative in selected clinical scenarios.

METHODS: In 824 patients presenting with chest pain at the emergency department of the University Hospital of Regensburg, pNT was assessed. A subset of 355 patients additionally provided uNT.

RESULTS: Both pNT and uNT were significantly increased in AFib, and lesser in atrial flutter (AFlut) and right ventricular (RV) pacing compared to SR (each p < 0.05). A pNT cutoff of 900 pg/mL yielded 74% sensitivity and 83% specificity for discriminating AFib from SR (AUC = 0.85). In multivariate regression, pNT or uNT and history of AFib were independent predictors of AFib (p < 0.05).

CONCLUSION: Both pNT and uNT are significantly elevated in AFib, and to a lesser extent AFlut, and RV pacing independently of heart failure. These findings align with prior observations and provide further evidence supporting adequately powered prospective studies to evaluate rhythm-adjusted diagnostic thresholds for CHF in AFib. In addition, uNT may complement pNT when venous access is difficult or serial remote monitoring is required.

AI.tldr: 在急诊胸痛患者中，血浆和尿NT-proBNP在房颤时显著升高，且独立于心力衰竭，血浆NT-proBNP诊断房颤的切点为900 pg/mL（敏感性74%、特异性83%）。
AI.motivation: NT-proBNP是诊断和监测充血性心力衰竭的金标准生物标志物，但其在检测房颤中的作用日益受到关注。本研究旨在评估异常心律对血浆NT-proBNP的影响，并探讨尿NT-proBNP作为无创替代标志物在特定临床场景中的价值。
AI.method: 在雷根斯堡大学医院急诊科连续纳入824例以胸痛就诊的患者，检测血浆NT-proBNP；其中355例患者额外提供尿液样本检测尿NT-proBNP。比较不同心律（窦性心律、房颤、心房扑动、右心室起搏）下NT-proBNP水平，采用ROC曲线确定诊断切点，多因素回归分析房颤的独立预测因素。
AI.result: 与窦性心律相比，房颤患者血浆和尿NT-proBNP均显著升高，心房扑动和右心室起搏者升高幅度较小（各p<0.05）。血浆NT-proBNP切点900 pg/mL区分房颤与窦性心律的敏感性74%、特异性83%（AUC=0.85）。多因素回归显示，血浆或尿NT-proBNP及房颤病史是房颤的独立预测因素（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 血浆和尿NT-proBNP在房颤时显著升高，心房扑动和右心室起搏时升高幅度较小，且独立于心力衰竭。这些发现与既往观察一致，支持开展足够效力的前瞻性研究以评估房颤患者中心力衰竭的诊断阈值需按心律调整。此外，在静脉通路困难或需要连续远程监测时，尿NT-proBNP可能作为血浆NT-proBNP的补充。

summary_zh:
引言：NT-proBNP 是诊断和监测充血性心力衰竭（CHF）的金标准生物标志物；然而，其在检测心房颤动（AFib）中的作用正受到关注。本研究评估了异常心脏节律对血浆 NT-proBNP（pNT）的影响，并考虑将尿液 NT-proBNP（uNT）作为特定临床场景下的无创替代方案。

方法：在雷根斯堡大学医院急诊科就诊的 824 例胸痛患者中评估了 pNT。其中 355 例患者额外提供了 uNT。

结果：与窦性心律（SR）相比，AFib 患者的 pNT 和 uNT 均显著升高，心房扑动（AFlut）和右心室（RV）起搏患者升高幅度较小（各 p < 0.05）。pNT 截断值 900 pg/mL 区分 AFib 与 SR 的敏感性为 74%，特异性为 83%（AUC = 0.85）。在多变量回归中，pNT 或 uNT 以及 AFib 病史是 AFib 的独立预测因素（p < 0.05）。

结论：pNT 和 uNT 在 AFib 中均显著升高，在 AFlut 和 RV 起搏中升高幅度较小，且独立于心力衰竭。这些发现与既往观察一致，并进一步支持开展充分把握度的前瞻性研究，以评估 AFib 中 CHF 的节律校正诊断阈值。此外，当静脉通路困难或需要连续远程监测时，uNT 可能补充 pNT。

title: Extended Wearable ECG Monitoring Detects Unrecognised Arrhythmias After COPD Exacerbation: The PRECURSOR Pilot Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The period after hospitalisation for an acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is associated with cardiovascular vulnerability. Clinically important rhythm disturbances may be intermittent or asymptomatic and escape routine postdischarge assessment; however, the diagnostic yield of prolonged monitoring is intrinsically influenced by monitoring duration.

METHODS: In this prospective, single-centre observational pilot, 18 adults recently hospitalised for COPD exacerbation underwent continuous remote monitoring for 21 days between September 2019 and February 2020. The three-lead ZENSOR wearable recorded electrocardiographic rhythm, heart rate and respiratory rate and transmitted full-disclosure data and predefined alerts for clinician review. The primary outcome was participant-level detection of previously unrecognised, cardiologist-confirmed arrhythmias warranting therapeutic evaluation or intervention. Outcomes were analysed descriptively with exact 95% binomial confidence intervals.

RESULTS: Participants were predominantly male (15/18; 83.3%), with a mean age of 73 ± 6 years. Seven had GOLD grade 3-4 airflow limitation, seven received long-term oxygen therapy, five had coronary artery disease and four had chronic atrial fibrillation. During the planned 21-day monitoring period, previously unrecognized clinically actionable arrhythmias were detected in 9/18 participants (50.0%; 95% CI: 26.0-74.0). Nonmutually exclusive findings included trigeminy (2/18), third-degree atrioventricular block (2/18), bradycardia (5/18), newly detected atrial fibrillation (1/18), supraventricular tachycardia (2/18) and nocturnal atrial or ventricular ectopy (8/18). Sixteen participants (88.9%; 95% CI: 65.3-98.6) reported satisfaction with monitoring.

CONCLUSIONS: Extended wearable electrocardiographic monitoring produced a high participant-level detection yield of previously unrecognised arrhythmias during early recovery from hospitalised COPD exacerbation. This finding supports targeted postdischarge rhythm surveillance but does not distinguish biological post-exacerbation vulnerability from the greater ascertainment achieved by prolonged monitoring. Confirmation requires larger controlled studies with comprehensive cardiopulmonary phenotyping, standardised monitoring-performance metrics and comparative clinical outcomes.

AI.tldr: COPD急性加重出院后21天穿戴式心电监测在50%患者中检出既往未识别、需临床处理的心律失常，支持出院后靶向心律监测。
AI.motivation: COPD急性加重住院后的早期恢复期心血管易损性升高，临床重要的心律失常可能呈间歇性或无症状，常规出院后评估容易漏诊；但延长监测的诊断收益本身受监测时长影响，既往缺乏该人群延长穿戴式心电监测检出率的数据。
AI.method: 前瞻性、单中心、观察性预试验（PRECURSOR），2019年9月至2020年2月纳入18例近期因COPD急性加重住院的成人，使用三导联ZENSOR穿戴设备连续远程监测21天，记录心电节律、心率与呼吸频率并传输全披露数据及预设警报供医生审阅。主要终点为受试者层面检出既往未识别、经心内科医生确认、需要治疗评估或干预的心律失常；采用描述性分析并计算精确95%二项置信区间。
AI.result: 受试者以男性为主（15/18，83.3%），平均年龄73±6岁；7例为GOLD 3-4级气流受限，7例长期氧疗，5例合并冠心病，4例为慢性房颤。21天监测期内，9/18例（50.0%；95% CI 26.0-74.0）检出既往未识别的临床可干预心律失常；非互斥发现包括三联律2/18、三度房室传导阻滞2/18、心动过缓5/18、新检出房颤1/18、室上性心动过速2/18、夜间房性或室性异位搏动8/18。16例（88.9%；95% CI 65.3-98.6）对监测表示满意。
AI.conclusion: COPD急性加重住院后早期恢复阶段，延长穿戴式心电监测可获得较高的既往未识别心律失常检出率，支持出院后靶向心律监测；但本研究无法区分急性加重后真实的生物学易损性与延长监测带来的更高检出率，且样本量小、单中心、无对照。结论需更大规模对照研究验证，并进行全面心肺表型评估、标准化监测性能指标及比较临床结局。

summary_zh:
背景：因慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）急性加重住院后的时期与心血管易感性相关。临床上重要的心律紊乱可能是间歇性的或无症状的，并逃逸出院后常规评估；然而，延长监测的诊断率本质上受监测持续时间的影响。

方法：在这项前瞻性、单中心观察性试点研究中，18名近期因COPD加重住院的成年人在2019年9月至2020年2月期间接受了连续远程监测21天。三导联ZENSOR可穿戴设备记录心电节律、心率和呼吸频率，并传输全披露数据和预定义警报供临床医生审查。主要结局是参与者层面检测到先前未被识别、经心脏病专家确认、需要治疗评估或干预的心律失常。结局以精确95%二项置信区间进行描述性分析。

结果：参与者主要为男性（15/18；83.3%），平均年龄73 ± 6岁。七名有GOLD 3-4级气流受限，七名接受长期氧疗，五名有冠状动脉疾病，四名有慢性心房颤动。在计划的21天监测期间，9/18名参与者（50.0%；95% CI：26.0-74.0）检测到先前未被识别的临床可操作心律失常。非互斥发现包括三联律（2/18）、三度房室传导阻滞（2/18）、心动过缓（5/18）、新检测到的心房颤动（1/18）、室上性心动过速（2/18）和夜间房性或室性异位搏动（8/18）。十六名参与者（88.9%；95% CI：65.3-98.6）报告对监测满意。

结论：延长可穿戴心电监测在住院COPD加重早期恢复期间对先前未被识别的心律失常产生了高参与者层面检测率。这一发现支持靶向出院后心律监测，但不能区分生物学上加重后易感性与延长监测实现的更高检出率。确认需要更大规模的对照研究，包括全面的心肺表型分析、标准化的监测性能指标和比较临床结局。

title: The efficacy of additional atrial driver ablation in persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) remains the primary ablation strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet its success in persistent (PeAF) and long-standing persistent AF (LS-PeAF) is suboptimal. Adjunctive ablation targeting atrial drivers has been proposed to enhance outcomes. This systematic review and meta-analysis compared PVI alone with PVI plus atrial driver ablation in PeAF and LS-PeAF.

METHODS: Comprehensive searches of PubMed, Scopus, Europe PMC, and Cochrane Library identified randomized controlled trials (RCTs) enrolling adults with PeAF or LS-PeAF undergoing first-time ablation. Eligible studies compared PVI alone versus PVI plus driver ablation and trials utilizing other adjunctive ablations were excluded. Outcomes included recurrence of AF and any atrial tachyarrhythmia (ATA) beyond the blanking period, procedural parameters, and complications. Pooled analyses employed random-effects models to measure risk ratios (RRs) and mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).

RESULTS: Seven RCTs met inclusion criteria. Adjunctive driver ablation modestly improved freedom from AF (RR 1.16; 95% CI, [1.03, 1.31]; p = 0.01; I²=61%). However, this finding was accompanied by substantial heterogeneity and was not robust to leave-one-out sensitivity analysis. Driver ablation failed to elevate freedom from any ATA (RR 1.09; 95% CI, [0.98, 1.20]; p = 0.11; I²=47%). Procedure duration (MD 37.81 min; 95% CI, [4.42, 71.20]; p = 0.03; I²=96%), fluoroscopy time (MD 4.25 min; 95% CI, [2.83, 5.67]; p < 0.00001; I²=0%), and ablation time (MD 10.01 min; 95% CI, [0.25, 19.77]; p = 0.04; I²=95%) were significantly longer with adjunctive driver ablation. Procedural complication rates were comparable among both groups (RR 1.65; 95% CI, [0.80, 3.43]; p = 0.18; I²=20%).

CONCLUSION: Additional atrial driver ablation modestly improves freedom from AF but does not reduce ATA recurrence, prolonging procedure time without increasing complications.

AI.tldr: 在持续性及长程持续性房颤患者中，PVI联合心房驱动灶消融较单纯PVI轻度提高无AF生存率（RR 1.16），但未减少任何房性快速性心律失常复发，且延长手术时间。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离（PVI）是房颤消融的基石，但对持续性（PeAF）和长程持续性房颤（LS-PeAF）的成功率不理想。针对心房驱动灶的辅助消融被提出以改善预后，但其在PeAF和LS-PeAF中的疗效尚不明确，需要系统评价和荟萃分析来比较PVI alone与PVI联合驱动灶消融的效果。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Scopus、Europe PMC和Cochrane Library，纳入7项随机对照试验（RCT），对象为接受首次消融的PeAF或LS-PeAF成人患者。比较PVI alone与PVI联合驱动灶消融，排除使用其他辅助消融的试验。终点包括空白期后AF复发和任何房性快速性心律失常（ATA）复发、手术参数及并发症。采用随机效应模型计算风险比（RR）和均数差（MD）及95%置信区间（CI）。
AI.result: 共纳入7项RCT。辅助驱动灶消融轻度提高无AF生存率（RR 1.16；95% CI [1.03, 1.31]；p=0.01；I²=61%），但异质性较大且留一法敏感性分析不稳健。未能提高无任何ATA生存率（RR 1.09；95% CI [0.98, 1.20]；p=0.11；I²=47%）。辅助消融组手术时间（MD 37.81 min；95% CI [4.42, 71.20]；p=0.03；I²=96%）、透视时间（MD 4.25 min；95% CI [2.83, 5.67]；p<0.00001；I²=0%）和消融时间（MD 10.01 min；95% CI [0.25, 19.77]；p=0.04；I²=95%）均显著延长。并发症发生率两组相当（RR 1.65；95% CI [0.80, 3.43]；p=0.18；I²=20%）。
AI.conclusion: 在PeAF和LS-PeAF患者中，PVI联合心房驱动灶消融可轻度改善无AF生存率，但未减少ATA复发，且延长手术时间而不增加并发症。该策略的获益有限且不稳健，临床决策需权衡手术时间与潜在获益，未来需更多高质量RCT验证。

summary_zh:
目的：肺静脉隔离（PVI）仍然是心房颤动（AF）的主要消融策略，但其在持续性（PeAF）和长程持续性心房颤动（LS-PeAF）中的成功率并不理想。针对心房驱动灶的辅助消融已被提出以改善预后。本系统评价和荟萃分析比较了在PeAF和LS-PeAF中单独PVI与PVI加心房驱动灶消融的效果。

方法：全面检索PubMed、Scopus、Europe PMC和Cochrane Library，筛选纳入接受首次消融的PeAF或LS-PeAF成年患者的随机对照试验（RCT）。符合条件的研究比较了单独PVI与PVI加驱动灶消融，排除了使用其他辅助消融的试验。结局包括空白期后AF和任何房性快速性心律失常（ATA）的复发、手术参数和并发症。汇总分析采用随机效应模型测量风险比（RR）和均数差（MD）及其95%置信区间（CI）。

结果：七项RCT符合纳入标准。辅助驱动灶消融适度改善了无AF生存（RR 1.16；95% CI，[1.03, 1.31]；p = 0.01；I²=61%）。然而，这一发现伴随显著异质性，且对留一法敏感性分析不稳健。驱动灶消融未能提高无任何ATA生存（RR 1.09；95% CI，[0.98, 1.20]；p = 0.11；I²=47%）。辅助驱动灶消融的手术时间（MD 37.81分钟；95% CI，[4.42, 71.20]；p = 0.03；I²=96%）、透视时间（MD 4.25分钟；95% CI，[2.83, 5.67]；p < 0.00001；I²=0%）和消融时间（MD 10.01分钟；95% CI，[0.25, 19.77]；p = 0.04；I²=95%）显著延长。两组手术并发症发生率相当（RR 1.65；95% CI，[0.80, 3.43]；p = 0.18；I²=20%）。

结论：额外的心房驱动灶消融适度改善无AF生存，但不减少ATA复发，延长手术时间而不增加并发症。

title: Role of reverse remodelling in recurrence of atrial fibrillation after patient-tailored catheter ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Catheter ablation (CA) is a curative treatment for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet success rates remain sub-optimal, with ∼50% of patients with persistent AF experiencing recurrence after 1 year. This may be due to the self-perpetuating nature of AF, which remodels atrial structure and cellular properties, while successful treatment can induce reverse remodelling (RR). This study develops a patient-specific CA strategy to directly target re-entrant drivers (RDs) and investigates the role of RR in AF recurrence.

METHODS: Left atrial (LA) models were reconstructed from LGE-MRI scans of AF patients (n = 15) and coupled with the Courtemanche-Ramirez-Nattel (CRN) electrophysiology model. RDs were induced via pacing, identified using DGM analysis, and targeted ablation was performed in-silico. Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) was applied as a reference. Following termination, AF recurrence was tested under three levels of electrical reverse remodelling (ERR: 0%, 50%, and 100%), with and without structural reverse remodelling (SRR).

RESULTS: Targeted ablation acutely terminated AF in all patient-specific models. After the first procedure, AF recurrence decreased progressively from 55% at 0% ERR to 36.7% at 50% ERR and 5% at 100% ERR; with additional SRR, recurrence was further reduced to 46.7%, 26.7%, and 0%, respectively. After the second CA procedure, AF recurrence rate was 42.9%, 17.9%, and 0% without SRR and 25%, 14.3%, and 0% with SRR.

CONCLUSION: This study highlights the importance of RR for therapy success, with a novel targeted CA technique ensuring <5% AF recurrence in patient-specific simulations. After clinical validation, this approach can help improve long-term patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在患者个体化左房模型中，靶向折返驱动灶消融可急性终止房颤，且电学与结构逆重构程度越高，消融后房颤复发率越低（100%电学逆重构时复发率仅5%）。
AI.motivation: 导管消融是房颤的根治性治疗，但成功率仍不理想，持续性房颤患者1年复发率约50%。房颤本身可导致心房结构和细胞电学重构而自我维持，成功治疗可诱导逆重构（RR），但RR在消融后房颤复发中的作用尚不明确。本研究旨在建立患者个体化消融策略直接靶向折返驱动灶（RDs），并探讨RR对房颤复发的影响。
AI.method: 研究类型为计算机仿真研究。基于15例房颤患者的LGE-MRI扫描重建左房模型，耦合Courtemanche-Ramirez-Nattel（CRN）电生理模型。通过起搏诱导RDs，采用DGM分析识别RDs，并在计算机（in-silico）中行靶向消融，以肺静脉隔离（PVI）作为参照。消融终止房颤后，在三种电学逆重构（ERR）水平（0%、50%、100%）下，分别在有或无结构逆重构（SRR）的条件下测试房颤复发。
AI.result: 靶向消融在所有患者个体化模型中均急性终止房颤。首次消融后，房颤复发率随ERR水平升高而逐渐降低：0% ERR时为55%，50% ERR时为36.7%，100% ERR时为5%；附加SRR后，复发率进一步分别降至46.7%、26.7%和0%。第二次消融后，无SRR时复发率分别为42.9%、17.9%和0%，有SRR时分别为25%、14.3%和0%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调了逆重构对治疗成功的重要性，新型靶向消融技术在患者个体化仿真中可实现<5%的房颤复发率。经临床验证后，该方法可能有助于改善患者的长期预后。局限性在于本研究为计算机仿真研究，样本量小（n=15），结果需临床验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：导管消融（CA）是心房颤动（AF）的根治性治疗手段，但成功率仍不理想，约50%的持续性AF患者在1年后复发。这可能归因于AF的自我维持特性，即AF会重塑心房结构和细胞特性，而成功的治疗可诱导逆向重塑（RR）。本研究开发了一种针对患者的CA策略，直接靶向折返驱动子（RDs），并探讨RR在AF复发中的作用。

方法：根据AF患者（n = 15）的LGE-MRI扫描重建左心房（LA）模型，并与Courtemanche-Ramirez-Nattel（CRN）电生理模型耦合。通过起搏诱导RDs，使用DGM分析识别，并在计算机模拟中进行靶向消融。以肺静脉隔离（PVI）作为参照。在终止后，分别在三种程度的电学逆向重塑（ERR：0%、50%和100%）下，无论是否联合结构性逆向重塑（SRR），测试AF复发情况。

结果：靶向消融在所有患者特异性模型中均急性终止了AF。首次手术后，AF复发率从0% ERR时的55%逐渐降至50% ERR时的36.7%和100% ERR时的5%；若额外联合SRR，复发率进一步分别降至46.7%、26.7%和0%。第二次CA手术后，无SRR时AF复发率分别为42.9%、17.9%和0%，有SRR时分别为25%、14.3%和0%。

结论：本研究强调了RR对治疗成功的重要性，一种新型靶向CA技术在患者特异性模拟中确保AF复发率<5%。经过临床验证后，该方法有助于改善患者的长期预后。

title: Controversy: Anticoagulants need to be maintained after catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation in patients at risk of stroke-Pro and Contra.
summary: The pillars of atrial fibrillation (AF) management include stroke prevention, patient-centred symptom directed decisions on rhythm or rate control, and the proactive management of comorbidities and lifestyle changes. These pillars are not in isolation; they are complementary to each other. While oral anticoagulants (OACs) are highly effective for reducing stroke and all-cause mortality in patients with AF, these drugs confer a risk of major bleeding, including intracranial bleeding. Evidence from clinical trials and observational data shows that early rhythm control, especially with catheter ablation, results in a reduction in stroke risk and/or the reduction in AF burden. The question arises therefore, whether in patients with intermediate or low stroke risk after successful catheter ablation, whether or not to continue or discontinue OAC. Recent randomized trials and observational data have created some debate about whether OAC can be routinely stopped after a successful catheter ablation procedure, without a higher risk of thromboembolism. In this pro/contra article, we will debate the arguments for and against the cessation of anti-coagulation after catheter ablation, in the context of recent evidence from clinical trials, observational data, and meta-analysis.

AI.tldr: 对于房颤消融成功后卒中风险中低危的患者，是否停用口服抗凝药仍存争议，近期随机试验与观察性数据提示部分患者或可安全停药，但证据尚不充分。
AI.motivation: 房颤管理的三大支柱包括卒中预防、症状导向的心律/心率控制以及合并症与生活方式管理。口服抗凝药（OAC）可显著降低卒中与全因死亡，但增加大出血（含颅内出血）风险。早期节律控制尤其是导管消融可降低卒中风险及房颤负荷，因此对于消融成功后卒中风险中低危的患者，是否继续或停用OAC成为临床难题。近期随机试验与观察性数据引发争议，本文旨在正反双方辩论停用抗凝的证据。
AI.method: 本文为Pro/Contra辩论文章，非原始研究。基于近期临床试验、观察性数据及荟萃分析，围绕房颤导管消融成功后是否停用OAC展开论证，重点讨论卒中风险中低危患者。摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。辩论双方引用近期随机试验和观察性数据，就消融成功后常规停用OAC是否增加血栓栓塞风险展开讨论，但未给出定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 目前证据尚不足以支持消融成功后对所有患者常规停用OAC，尤其卒中风险中低危者需个体化评估。临床实践中应结合患者卒中风险、出血风险及消融结果综合决策，未来需更多随机试验明确安全停药标准。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）管理的支柱包括卒中预防、以患者为中心的症状导向的节律或心率控制决策，以及合并症和生活方式改变的积极管理。这些支柱并非孤立存在；它们相互补充。虽然口服抗凝药（OACs）在降低AF患者卒中和全因死亡率方面高度有效，但这些药物带来大出血风险，包括颅内出血。临床试验和观察性数据的证据表明，早期节律控制，尤其是通过导管消融，可导致卒中风险降低和/或AF负荷减少。因此，问题在于，对于成功导管消融后中等或低卒中风险的患者，是否继续或停止OAC。近期随机试验和观察性数据引发了一些争论，即成功导管消融术后是否可以常规停止OAC而不增加血栓栓塞风险。在这篇正反方文章中，我们将结合近期临床试验、观察性数据和荟萃分析的证据，辩论导管消融后停止抗凝的赞成与反对论点。

title: Remote activity and rhythm monitoring using patient-owned consumer devices after first-time pulmonary vein isolation.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Passively collected physical activity data from consumer devices could provide a scalable, objective measure of functional status in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). This study assessed the feasibility of remotely collecting activity and rhythm data from patients undergoing index pulmonary vein isolation (PVI).

METHODS: AF patients enrolled in the prospective TRUST registry who underwent index PVI and reported owning an eligible smartphone were re-contacted to provide informed consent and share their smartphone- and smartwatch-generated data. Pre-specified feasibility criteria were participation rate, technical success, and temporal data coverage. The primary functional outcome was the mean daily step-count change between the one-year pre-PVI and two-year post-PVI windows. Exploratory analyses examined associations of daily activity with AF recurrence and AF burden.

RESULTS: Of 280 eligible patients, 172 (61%) attempted and 154/172 (90%) completed data transfer, of whom 123 met pre-specified completeness criteria. Median monitoring duration was 6.0 [3.6, 6.6] years, with 98% [77, 100] coverage. Mean daily step count increased from 5731±2808 to 6220±2816 steps/day after PVI (+488 steps/day [187, 789]; p=0.002). In 35 smartwatch users, AF burden decreased from 3.6% [1.6, 10.8] to 0.0% [0.0, 0.3] after PVI (p<0.001). Baseline AF burden was inversely correlated with daily step count (ρ=-0.36, p=0.035).

CONCLUSION: Remote collection of activity and rhythm data from consumer smartphones and smartwatches is feasible, yielding high-coverage, multi-year research data. This enables scalable, objective quantification of longitudinal functional outcomes. Daily step count increased after PVI in this exploratory cohort and was inversely related to baseline AF burden.

AI.tldr: 首次肺静脉隔离后，利用患者自有的智能手机和智能手表远程收集活动与节律数据可行，日均步数从5731增至6220步/天（+488步/天，P=0.002），且基线AF负荷与步数负相关。
AI.motivation: 消费者设备被动采集的体力活动数据有望成为AF患者功能状态的客观、可扩展指标，但首次PVI后远程收集活动与节律数据的可行性及纵向功能变化尚不明确。
AI.method: 前瞻性TRUST注册研究中，280例首次PVI且拥有合格智能手机的AF患者被重新联系，172例同意共享手机/手表数据。预设可行性标准为参与率、技术成功率和时间数据覆盖率。主要功能终点为PVI前1年至PVI后2年日均步数变化；探索性分析评估日常活动与AF复发及AF负荷的关联。
AI.conclusion: 利用消费者智能手机和智能手表远程收集活动与节律数据可行，可获得高覆盖率、多年研究数据，实现纵向功能结局的可扩展客观量化。本探索性队列中PVI后日均步数增加，且与基线AF负荷负相关；但样本量有限、为探索性分析，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：从消费设备被动收集的体力活动数据可为房颤（AF）患者提供一种可扩展的、客观的功能状态测量方法。本研究评估了从接受首次肺静脉隔离（PVI）的患者中远程收集活动和节律数据的可行性。

方法：前瞻性TRUST注册研究中接受首次PVI并报告拥有合格智能手机的AF患者被重新联系，以提供知情同意并分享其智能手机和智能手表生成的数据。预先设定的可行性标准为参与率、技术成功率和时间数据覆盖率。主要功能结局是PVI前一年与PVI后两年窗口之间的平均每日步数变化。探索性分析检查了每日活动与AF复发和AF负荷的关联。

结果：在280名符合条件的患者中，172名（61%）尝试并154/172名（90%）完成了数据传输，其中123名符合预先设定的完整性标准。中位监测持续时间为6.0 [3.6, 6.6]年，覆盖率为98% [77, 100]。PVI后平均每日步数从5731±2808步/天增加至6220±2816步/天（+488步/天 [187, 789]；p=0.002）。在35名智能手表用户中，PVI后AF负荷从3.6% [1.6, 10.8]降至0.0% [0.0, 0.3]（p<0.001）。基线AF负荷与每日步数呈负相关（ρ=-0.36，p=0.035）。

结论：从消费级智能手机和智能手表远程收集活动和节律数据是可行的，可产生高覆盖率、多年的研究数据。这使得能够可扩展地、客观地量化纵向功能结局。在这个探索性队列中，PVI后每日步数增加，并与基线AF负荷呈负相关。

title: Behavior-Based Electrogram Mapping Identifies Potential Functional Substrates in Atrial Fibrillation: The KSP-AF Randomized Study
summary: Abstract Background and Aims Conventional substrate mapping during atrial fibrillation (AF) may fail to capture dynamic electrogram behavior. Key spatiotemporal potentials (KSPs) are electrogram patterns identified by their temporal behavior during AF. We evaluated whether KSP-guided ablation improves outcomes beyond pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) and characterized their short-term frequency consistency. Methods In this single-center randomized study, 100 patients with paroxysmal or persistent AF undergoing first-time ablation were assigned to PVI plus KSP-guided ablation or PVI alone. The primary endpoint was 24-month single-procedure freedom from documented AF recurrence without antiarrhythmic drugs. Dominant frequency (DF) analysis included 93 KSP regions from 18 patients, assessed across four consecutive 5-second epochs. Results Acute AF termination occurred in 68% of patients with PVI + KSP versus 26% with PVI alone (P < 0.001). At 24 months, freedom from AF recurrence was 74% versus 48% (HR 0.38, 95% CI 0.18–0.79; P = 0.010), and freedom from AF/atrial tachycardia recurrence was 68% versus 46% (HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.25–0.97; P = 0.040). Within-recording temporal DF variability was low (coefficient of variation, 4.8 ± 1.2%). Conclusion Adding KSP-guided ablation to PVI improved acute and 24-month rhythm outcomes in this single-center trial. These findings support further evaluation of behavior-based mapping to identify potential functional AF substrates and require multicenter confirmation.

AI.tldr: 在首次消融的房颤患者中，PVI联合KSP引导消融较单纯PVI显著提高24个月无复发率（74% vs 48%），并增加急性房颤终止率。
AI.motivation: 传统房颤基质标测可能无法捕捉电图的动态行为，既往证据对基于行为特征的标测能否改善消融预后尚不明确，本研究评估KSP引导消融在PVI基础上能否提升疗效并描述其短期频率一致性。
AI.method: 单中心随机研究，纳入100例首次接受消融的阵发性或持续性房颤患者，随机分配至PVI联合KSP引导消融组或单纯PVI组。主要终点为24个月单次手术后不使用抗心律失常药物情况下无记录到的房颤复发。对18例患者的93个KSP区域进行优势频率（DF）分析，在连续四个5秒片段中评估。
AI.result: 急性房颤终止率在PVI+KSP组为68%，单纯PVI组为26%（P<0.001）。24个月无房颤复发率分别为74%和48%（HR 0.38，95%CI 0.18–0.79；P=0.010）；无房颤/房性心动过速复发率分别为68%和46%（HR 0.49，95%CI 0.25–0.97；P=0.040）。记录内DF时间变异性低（变异系数4.8±1.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 在单中心试验中，PVI联合KSP引导消融改善了急性和24个月节律结局，支持进一步评估基于行为特征的标测以识别潜在功能性房颤基质，但需多中心验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：心房颤动（AF）期间的常规基质标测可能无法捕捉动态的心电图行为。关键时空电位（KSP）是根据AF期间的时间行为识别出的心电图模式。我们评估了KSP引导的消融是否能在肺静脉隔离（PVI）之外改善结局，并描述了其短期频率一致性。

方法：在这项单中心随机研究中，100例接受首次消融的阵发性或持续性AF患者被分配至PVI联合KSP引导消融组或单纯PVI组。主要终点为24个月单次手术后无抗心律失常药物情况下无记录到的AF复发。优势频率（DF）分析包括来自18例患者的93个KSP区域，在连续四个5秒时段内进行评估。

结果：PVI+KSP组68%的患者出现急性AF终止，而单纯PVI组为26%（P < 0.001）。在24个月时，无AF复发率分别为74%和48%（HR 0.38，95% CI 0.18–0.79；P = 0.010），无AF/房性心动过速复发率分别为68%和46%（HR 0.49，95% CI 0.25–0.97；P = 0.040）。记录内时间DF变异性较低（变异系数，4.8 ± 1.2%）。

结论：在这项单中心试验中，在PVI基础上增加KSP引导消融改善了急性和24个月节律结局。这些发现支持进一步评估基于行为的标测以识别潜在的功能性AF基质，并需要多中心确认。

title: Pseudo-Conduction After Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation: Insights From High-Density Mapping.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Bidirectional cavotricuspid isthmus (CTI) block is the procedural endpoint of typical atrial flutter ablation, but pseudo-conduction may mimic residual isthmus conduction.

CASE SUMMARY: A 45-year-old man underwent CTI ablation for typical atrial flutter. After linear ablation, a short double-potential interval and simplified differential pacing suggested residual conduction near the inferior vena cava (IVC). Additional ablation at this region failed to change the activation pattern. High-density mapping ultimately confirmed complete CTI block, whereas rapid activation around the IVC reached the lateral right atrium early, creating a pseudo-residual conduction pattern. The patient had no complications and remained free from recurrence during 9-month follow-up.

DISCUSSION: Rapid conduction around the IVC may confound conventional criteria for CTI block.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: High-density mapping may help differentiate true residual conduction from pseudo-conduction and prevent unnecessary ablation.

AI.tldr: 高密度标测可识别典型房扑CTI消融后因IVC周围快速传导造成的假性传导，避免不必要的额外消融。
AI.motivation: 双向CTI阻滞是典型房扑消融的手术终点，但假性传导可能被误判为残余峡部传导，导致不必要的额外消融。常规标测和起搏方法在鉴别真假传导上存在局限，既往证据缺乏高密度标测在此场景下的应用经验。
AI.method: 单病例报告。45岁男性典型房扑患者接受CTI线性消融，术后出现短双电位间期和简化差异起搏提示IVC附近残余传导，再次消融后激动模式未变，遂行高密度标测明确诊断。主要观察指标为高密度标测下的CTI阻滞状态及随访复发情况。

title: Atypical Atrial Flutter From Lipomatous Hypertrophy of the Interatrial Septum in a Procedure-Naive Patient.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum (LHIS) is generally benign and often discovered incidentally; however, it can occasionally serve as a substrate for atrial arrhythmias.

CASE SUMMARY: An 86-year-old man with no prior cardiac history presented with new onset atrial flutter (AFL) with an atrial rate of 280 beats/min. During an electrophysiology study, intracardiac echocardiography identified LHIS. Three-dimensional electroanatomic activation mapping demonstrated the earliest focal activation at the superior posteroseptal right atrium, corresponding to the location of the LHIS. Radiofrequency ablation at this site terminated the AFL, rendering the tachycardia noninducible.

DISCUSSION: LHIS can act as an isolated arrhythmogenic substrate for atypical AFL. The combination of intracardiac echocardiography and high-density electroanatomic mapping allows precise localization of the arrhythmogenic focus, facilitating safe and effective catheter ablation.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: LHIS should be considered a potential arrhythmogenic substrate in patients with atypical AFL. Catheter ablation of LHIS-associated AFL is safe and effective.

AI.tldr: 86岁无心脏手术史男性新发非典型房扑，电生理检查证实房间隔脂肪瘤样肥厚为致心律失常基质，射频消融成功终止且不可诱发。
AI.motivation: 房间隔脂肪瘤样肥厚（LHIS）通常为良性且偶然发现，但偶可作为房性心律失常的基质；既往对其作为孤立致心律失常病灶导致非典型房扑的报道有限，需明确其电生理特征及消融策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为86岁无既往心脏病史、新发心房率280次/分的房扑男性。行电生理检查，应用心腔内超声（ICE）识别LHIS，三维电解剖激动标测定位最早激动点，并行射频消融。终点为房扑终止及不可诱发。
AI.result: ICE识别LHIS；三维电解剖激动标测显示最早局灶激动位于右心房上后间隔，与LHIS位置对应；该部位射频消融终止房扑，且术后房扑不可诱发。摘要未报告具体消融参数、手术时间及随访数据。
AI.conclusion: LHIS可作为非典型房扑的孤立致心律失常基质；ICE联合高密度电解剖标测可精准定位病灶，指导安全有效的导管消融。临床遇非典型房扑时应考虑LHIS可能，但本结论基于单例病例，需更多研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：房间隔脂肪瘤样肥厚（LHIS）通常为良性，常为偶然发现；然而，它偶尔可作为房性心律失常的基质。

病例摘要：一名86岁男性，既往无心脏病史，表现为新发心房扑动（AFL），心房率为280次/分。在电生理检查中，心腔内超声识别出LHIS。三维电解剖激动标测显示最早局灶激动位于右心房后上间隔部，与LHIS的位置相对应。在该部位进行射频消融终止了AFL，使心动过速不再被诱发。

讨论：LHIS可作为非典型AFL的孤立性致心律失常基质。心腔内超声与高密度电解剖标测的结合能够精确识别致心律失常病灶，有助于安全有效的导管消融。

要点总结：对于非典型AFL患者，LHIS应被视为潜在的致心律失常基质。LHIS相关AFL的导管消融安全有效。

title: Atrial Fibrillation With a Most Regular Rhythm.
Pulsed Field Versus Contact Force Radiofrequency Ablation in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) remains a challenging arrhythmia to manage, and catheter ablation is a cornerstone therapy. Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) has recently emerged as a novel non-thermal alternative to Contact Force Radiofrequency (CF-RF) ablation. This meta-analysis compares the efficacy, safety, and procedural efficiency of PFA versus CF-RF in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation.

METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted using randomized controlled trials and cohort studies identified from MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane databases. Primary outcomes included 12-month freedom from atrial arrhythmia (AF, atrial flutter, or atrial tachycardia), procedure duration, fluoroscopy time, and major complications. Subgroup analyses were performed based on PFA device type (Farapulse vs. HT-9000Pro) and patient characteristics, including left atrial size and AF duration.

RESULTS: Seventeen studies met inclusion criteria. PFA was associated with significantly higher 12-month freedom from atrial arrhythmia compared with CF-RF (OR = 1.36, 95% CI 1.26-1.47, p < 0.001). Procedure time was markedly shorter with PFA (MD = -40.5 minutes, p < 0.001), while fluoroscopy time also showed a significant reduction (MD = -1.8 minutes, p = 0.001). Major complications were significantly lower with PFA (1.2% vs. 2.8%; OR = 0.44, 95% CI 0.35-0.57, p < 0.001).

CONCLUSION: In persistent AF, PFA, demonstrates superior efficacy, safety, and procedural efficiency compared with CF-RFA, supporting its role as a potential first-line ablation strategy. Larger multicenter trials with long-term follow-up are needed to confirm durability and device-specific outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤患者中，脉冲场消融较接触力射频消融12个月无房性心律失常生存率更高、手术时间更短、主要并发症更少。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤的导管消融治疗仍具挑战性，脉冲场消融作为新型非热消融方式，与接触力射频消融的头对头比较证据有限，尤其缺乏针对持续性房颤人群的疗效、安全性和手术效率的系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane数据库，纳入随机对照试验和队列研究，比较脉冲场消融与接触力射频消融在持续性房颤患者中的效果。主要终点为12个月无房性心律失常（房颤、房扑或房速）生存率、手术时间、透视时间和主要并发症。按脉冲场消融设备类型（Farapulse vs. HT-9000Pro）及患者特征（左房大小、房颤持续时间）进行亚组分析。
AI.result: 共纳入17项研究。脉冲场消融组12个月无房性心律失常生存率显著高于接触力射频消融组（OR=1.36，95%CI 1.26-1.47，P<0.001）。手术时间显著缩短（MD=-40.5分钟，P<0.001），透视时间亦显著减少（MD=-1.8分钟，P=0.001）。主要并发症发生率显著更低（1.2% vs. 2.8%；OR=0.44，95%CI 0.35-0.57，P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 在持续性房颤中，脉冲场消融较接触力射频消融在疗效、安全性和手术效率方面均具优势，支持其作为潜在的一线消融策略。但需更大规模、长期随访的多中心试验确认其持久性和设备特异性结局。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）仍然是一种管理具有挑战性的心律失常，导管消融是基石疗法。脉冲场消融（PFA）最近作为一种新型非热替代方案出现，用于替代接触力射频（CF-RF）消融。本荟萃分析比较了PFA与CF-RF在持续性心房颤动患者中的疗效、安全性和手术效率。

方法：使用从MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane数据库识别的随机对照试验和队列研究进行了系统评价和荟萃分析。主要结局包括12个月无房性心律失常（AF、心房扑动或房性心动过速）、手术持续时间、透视时间和主要并发症。根据PFA设备类型（Farapulse vs. HT-9000Pro）和患者特征（包括左心房大小和AF持续时间）进行亚组分析。

结果：17项研究符合纳入标准。与CF-RF相比，PFA与显著更高的12个月无房性心律失常相关（OR = 1.36，95% CI 1.26-1.47，p < 0.001）。PFA的手术时间明显更短（MD = -40.5分钟，p < 0.001），而透视时间也显示出显著减少（MD = -1.8分钟，p = 0.001）。PFA的主要并发症显著更低（1.2% vs. 2.8%；OR = 0.44，95% CI 0.35-0.57，p < 0.001）。

结论：在持续性AF中，PFA与CF-RFA相比表现出更优的疗效、安全性和手术效率，支持其作为潜在一线消融策略的作用。需要更大规模的多中心试验和长期随访来确认耐久性和设备特异性结局。

title: Recurrent Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection.
summary: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) is a rare but increasingly recognized cause of acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and sudden cardiac death. It has been associated with several predisposing factors, including hormone replacement therapy, autoimmune disorders, fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD), connective tissue diseases, atherosclerosis, migraine, pregnancy, and the postpartum period. SCAD most commonly affects young to middle-aged women who present with acute myocardial infarction (MI) despite the absence of traditional atherosclerotic risk factors. Coronary angiography remains the gold standard for diagnosis, allowing visualization of the characteristic dissection patterns within the coronary vessel wall. Management is typically conservative as spontaneous healing of the dissection is common; however, revascularization with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) or coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) may be necessary in patients with hemodynamic instability, ongoing ischemia, or failure of medical therapy.

title: Restitution properties during ventricular fibrillation and the effects of cardiac pacing location on ventricular electrophysiology in the rabbit heart.
summary: Sudden cardiac death is a cause of mortality due to malignant arrhythmias such as ventricular fibrillation (VF). Although action potential duration (APD) restitution is a method to assess arrhythmic susceptibility, repolarisation may depend on prior activation history, a phenomenon known as cardiac memory. Cardiac memory describes the persistence of repolarisation effects from previous beats, such that APD reflects not only the immediately preceding diastolic interval (DI) but also earlier activation effects. This may be relevant during VF, where continuously varying activation patterns prevent a steady electrophysiological state. This study investigated how pacing location affects ventricular electrophysiology and whether repolarisation during VF exhibits short-term cardiac memory. Langendorff-perfused rabbit hearts were used to record monophasic action potentials from the left ventricular apex and base. Pacing was conducted from five sites. Steady-state APD was assessed during constant pacing. Effective refractory period (ERP), APD restitution and conduction time restitution (CTR) were assessed using an S1-S2 extra-stimulus protocol (S1, conditioning stimuli; S2, premature extra-stimulus). Additionally, APD-DI and APD-APD relationships were analysed during early VF. Pacing location significantly influenced S1 and S2 conduction delays, consistent with site-dependent activation timing. However, steady-state APD, ERP and CTR were not significantly affected by pacing location. In contrast, during VF, APD exhibited a significant dependence on preceding DI and preceding APD over approximately the first 30 beats, with these relationships progressively deteriorating thereafter. These findings demonstrate that while pacing location alters activation timing, repolarisation dynamics under stable activation histories are robust. During VF, continuously changing activation patterns unmask short-term cardiac memory.

AI.tldr: 在兔心脏中，起搏部位影响传导延迟但不影响稳态复极；室颤早期约30个心搏内动作电位时程显示对前一心动周期的短期心脏记忆。
AI.motivation: 室颤是心源性猝死的主要原因，动作电位时程恢复特性用于评估致心律失常易感性，但复极可能依赖先前激活历史（心脏记忆），而室颤中连续变化的激活模式使电生理状态不稳定，起搏部位对心室电生理及室颤中复极是否表现短期心脏记忆尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用Langendorff灌注兔心脏，从左室心尖和基底记录单相动作电位，从5个部位起搏。恒定起搏评估稳态APD；S1-S2额外刺激方案评估有效不应期、APD恢复特性和传导时间恢复特性；室颤早期分析APD-DI和APD-APD关系。摘要未报告样本量和具体统计方法。
AI.result: 起搏部位显著影响S1和S2传导延迟，与部位依赖的激活时序一致；但稳态APD、ERP和CTR不受起搏部位显著影响。室颤期间，APD在约前30个心搏内显著依赖前一个DI和前一个APD，此后这些关系逐渐减弱。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间和P值。
AI.conclusion: 起搏部位改变激活时序，但在稳定激活历史下复极动力学稳健；室颤中连续变化的激活模式揭示短期心脏记忆。这提示室颤中复极评估需考虑心脏记忆，但结论基于兔离体心脏，临床转化受限，且摘要未报告关键统计数值。

summary_zh:
背景：心源性猝死是恶性心律失常如心室颤动（VF）导致死亡的原因。尽管动作电位时程（APD）恢复特性是评估心律失常易感性的方法，但复极可能依赖于先前的激活历史，这一现象称为心脏记忆。心脏记忆描述了先前搏动的复极效应持续存在，使得APD不仅反映紧邻的前一个舒张间期（DI），还反映更早的激活效应。这在VF期间可能相关，因为持续变化的激活模式阻止了稳定的电生理状态。本研究探讨了起搏位置如何影响心室电生理，以及VF期间的复极是否表现出短期心脏记忆。

方法：使用Langendorff灌流的兔心脏，记录左心室心尖和基底部的单相动作电位。从五个部位进行起搏。在恒定起搏期间评估稳态APD。使用S1-S2额外刺激协议（S1，条件刺激；S2，提前额外刺激）评估有效不应期（ERP）、APD恢复特性和传导时间恢复特性（CTR）。此外，在早期VF期间分析APD-DI和APD-APD关系。

结果：起搏位置显著影响S1和S2传导延迟，与部位依赖性激活时序一致。然而，稳态APD、ERP和CTR未受起搏位置的显著影响。相反，在VF期间，APD在约前30个搏动内表现出对前一个DI和前一个APD的显著依赖性，此后这些关系逐渐恶化。

结论：这些发现表明，虽然起搏位置改变激活时序，但在稳定激活历史下的复极动力学是稳健的。在VF期间，持续变化的激活模式揭示了短期心脏记忆。

title: [Machine learning-based prediction of sudden cardiac death in the general population using electronic health record data].
Electrocardiographic screening in paediatric and adolescent athletes: a 6-year prospective observational study from a Swiss mass-participation race.
summary:
NTRODUCTION: Pre-participation cardiovascular screening with resting 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG) is recommended by most sports societies to detect conditions associated with sudden cardiac death. While the ideal age to initiate screening remains controversial, an expert consensus paper written in Switzerland suggested starting ECG screening at 15 years of age. As part of the Swiss multicentre prospective ECG screening study (Swiss PAED), we initiated an ECG screening programme in 2018 in conjunction with the Course de l'Escalade, a popular Geneva running event attracting over 10,000 children and adolescents annually.

METHODS: This prospective observational study was conducted between 2018 and 2024 (excluding 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic) during the Course de l'Escalade in Geneva, Switzerland. Competitive athletes aged 8-17 years training ≥6 hours per week in organised sport and without known cardiac disease were invited to undergo pre-participation cardiovascular evaluation including medical history, physical examination and resting 12-lead ECG. ECGs were interpreted according to the 2017 international criteria for athlete ECG interpretation and classified as normal, borderline or abnormal. Abnormal ECGs were referred for specialist cardiology evaluation.

RESULTS: A total of 428 athletes (239 boys; mean age 12.9 [2.7] years) were enrolled. Normal variants were observed in 298/428 athletes (69.6%), most frequently sinus arrhythmia (183/428, 42.8%). Borderline findings in isolation occurred in 30/428 athletes (7.0%), most often right atrial enlargement (16/30, 3.7%). Abnormal findings were detected in 7/428 (1.6%) athletes, among whom 2/7 were subsequently found to have a condition associated with sudden cardiac death: Wolff-Parkinson-White pattern.

CONCLUSION: ECG-based screening during the Course de l'Escalade identified abnormal findings in 1.6% of young athletes among whom 2/7 were found to harbour a disease associated with sudden cardiac death. Current international interpretation criteria performed well in this population of young competitive athletes.

AI.tldr: 在瑞士大众跑步活动中对428名8-17岁青少年运动员进行心电图筛查，1.6%发现异常，其中2例为预激综合征（WPW），提示该人群筛查可行且国际判读标准适用。
AI.motivation: 赛前12导联静息心电图筛查被多数体育学会推荐用于检出与心源性猝死相关的疾病，但开始筛查的理想年龄仍有争议；瑞士专家共识建议从15岁开始，而更低年龄段的筛查数据有限。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察研究，2018-2024年（排除2020年因COVID-19）在日内瓦Course de l'Escalade跑步活动期间纳入8-17岁、每周训练≥6小时、无已知心脏病的竞技运动员，进行病史、体格检查和静息12导联心电图，按2017年国际运动员心电图判读标准分类为正常、临界或异常，异常者转诊心脏专科评估。

引言：大多数体育学会推荐使用静息12导联心电图（ECG）进行赛前心血管筛查，以发现与心源性猝死相关的疾病。虽然开始筛查的理想年龄仍存在争议，但瑞士撰写的一份专家共识文件建议从15岁开始进行ECG筛查。作为瑞士多中心前瞻性ECG筛查研究（Swiss PAED）的一部分，我们于2018年结合Course de l'Escalade（一项每年吸引超过10,000名儿童和青少年的日内瓦热门跑步活动）启动了一项ECG筛查计划。

方法：这项前瞻性观察研究于2018年至2024年间（因COVID-19大流行排除2020年）在瑞士日内瓦的Course de l'Escalade期间进行。年龄8-17岁、每周在组织性运动中训练≥6小时且无已知心脏病的竞技运动员被邀请接受赛前心血管评估，包括病史、体格检查和静息12导联ECG。ECG根据2017年运动员ECG解读国际标准进行解读，并分类为正常、临界或异常。异常ECG被转诊至心脏专科评估。

title: Development and Validation of a Risk Prediction Model for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is associated with an increased risk of incident atrial fibrillation (AF). Existing AF prediction scores were developed primarily in general populations, and their transportability to patients with COPD remains insufficiently established. This study aimed to develop and temporally validate a novel, disease-specific AF prediction model for patients with COPD.

METHODS: A total of 8385 COPD patients without prior AF from the UK Biobank (UKB) were included. Participants recruited in 2006-2009 formed the development set and those recruited in 2010 formed a temporal validation set. Cox proportional hazards, Elastic Net, random survival forest, and DeepSurv models were developed using clinical, biochemical, treatment-related, and genetic predictors. Performance was assessed using C-index, time-dependent AUC, Brier score, calibration, and decision-curve analysis, with 95% confidence intervals from 1000 participant-level bootstrap samples. Models were compared with CHARGE-AF and HARMS2-AF.

RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 14.17 years, 1402 participants developed AF. Internal validation C-indices were 0.748 for Cox, 0.750 for Elastic Net, 0.738 for random survival forest, and 0.745 for DeepSurv; temporal validation values were 0.705, 0.706, 0.696, and 0.712, respectively. In temporal validation, Elastic Net showed higher discrimination than CHARGE-AF (C-index difference, 0.047; 95% CI, 0.022-0.073) and HARMS2-AF (0.061; 95% CI, 0.032-0.090). Decision-curve analysis suggested potential clinical utility across selected 5-year thresholds. The Elastic Net model was implemented in an interactive web application.

CONCLUSION: AF risk prediction in COPD achieved moderate discrimination across several modeling approaches. The developed models showed higher discrimination than published AF risk scores in several analyses, particularly in temporal validation, supporting further evaluation of individualized AF risk stratification in patients with COPD.

AI.tldr: 在8385例无房颤史的COPD患者中构建并时间验证房颤风险预测模型，Elastic Net模型区分度中等（时间验证C指数0.706），优于CHARGE-AF与HARMS2-AF。
AI.motivation: COPD患者新发房颤风险升高，但现有房颤预测评分主要基于一般人群开发，其在COPD人群中的可迁移性尚不明确，缺乏疾病特异性预测工具。
AI.method: 基于UK Biobank的8385例既往无房颤的COPD患者，2006-2009年招募者构成开发集，2010年招募者构成时间验证集。利用临床、生化、治疗相关及遗传预测因子，分别构建Cox比例风险、Elastic Net、随机生存森林和DeepSurv模型；以C指数、时间依赖AUC、Brier评分、校准和决策曲线分析评估性能，采用1000次参与者水平bootstrap估计95%CI，并与CHARGE-AF、HARMS2-AF评分比较。
AI.result: 中位随访14.17年，1402例发生房颤。内部验证C指数：Cox 0.748、Elastic Net 0.750、随机生存森林0.738、DeepSurv 0.745；时间验证分别为0.705、0.706、0.696、0.712。时间验证中Elastic Net区分度高于CHARGE-AF（C指数差0.047，95%CI 0.022-0.073）和HARMS2-AF（0.061，95%CI 0.032-0.090）。决策曲线分析提示在部分5年阈值上具有潜在临床效用，Elastic Net模型已实现为交互式网页应用。
AI.conclusion: 多种建模方法对COPD患者房颤风险预测均达中等区分度，所建模型在部分分析尤其是时间验证中优于已发表房颤风险评分，支持在COPD人群中进一步评估个体化房颤风险分层；但区分度仅为中等，且为观察性队列数据，外部验证与临床获益尚待前瞻性研究确认。

summary_zh:
背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）与心房颤动（AF）发病风险增加相关。现有的AF预测评分主要基于一般人群开发，其向COPD患者的可移植性尚未充分确立。本研究旨在为COPD患者开发并时间验证一种新的疾病特异性AF预测模型。

方法：共纳入来自英国生物银行（UKB）的8385例无AF病史的COPD患者。2006-2009年招募的参与者构成开发集，2010年招募的参与者构成时间验证集。使用临床、生化、治疗相关和遗传预测因子开发了Cox比例风险、弹性网络、随机生存森林和DeepSurv模型。通过C-index、时间依赖AUC、Brier评分、校准和决策曲线分析评估性能，95%置信区间来自1000个参与者级bootstrap样本。模型与CHARGE-AF和HARMS2-AF进行比较。

结果：在中位随访14.17年期间，1402例参与者发生AF。内部验证C-index分别为Cox 0.748、弹性网络0.750、随机生存森林0.738和DeepSurv 0.745；时间验证值分别为0.705、0.706、0.696和0.712。在时间验证中，弹性网络显示出比CHARGE-AF（C-index差异，0.047；95% CI，0.022-0.073）和HARMS2-AF（0.061；95% CI，0.032-0.090）更高的区分度。决策曲线分析提示在选定的5年阈值上具有潜在临床效用。弹性网络模型已在交互式网络应用中实现。

结论：COPD中的AF风险预测在几种建模方法中达到了中等区分度。所开发的模型在多项分析中显示出比已发表的AF风险评分更高的区分度，尤其是在时间验证中，支持对COPD患者进行个体化AF风险分层的进一步评估。

title: hERG-activating compound ICA-105574 induces P-wave disappearance and cardiac arrest in isoflurane-anesthetized guinea pigs.
summary: The human ether-à-go-go-related gene 1 (hERG1) encodes the pore subunit of a voltage-dependent K+ channel that mediates the rapid delayed-rectifier K+ current (IKr). Since patients with short QT syndrome (SQTS) carrying gain-of-function mutation in hERG1 have an elevated risk of lethal arrhythmias, small compounds that activate hERG/IKr channels may also pose a similar arrhythmic risk. To investigate the proarrhythmic risks associated with an hERG activator, we examined electrocardiogram (ECG) changes in an isoflurane-anesthetized guinea pig model upon the administration of ICA-105574, which has been reported to increase IKr in guinea pig myocytes. In the 10 mg/kg ICA-105574 group, ECG changes including pronounced QT shortening were observed. Meanwhile, all the animals treated with 30 mg/kg ICA-105574 exhibited cardiac arrest. The estimated unbound plasma concentration at the maximal point of action at 10 mg/kg of ICA-105574 was 0.54 µM, which was comparable to the half maximal effective concentration of hERG activation by ICA-105574 in the patch clamp study (0.49 µM). Furthermore, 0.15 mg/kg E-4031, a selective hERG inhibitor, prevented cardiac arrest induced by 30 mg/kg ICA-105574. These findings suggest that increased IKr induced by ICA-105574 causes cardiac arrest. Our data demonstrated that ICA-105574 has serious proarrhythmic risks, including cardiac arrest. For the development of ICA-105574 and other hERG-activating compounds as candidate therapeutic agents, it is imperative that proarrhythmic risks should be comprehensively evaluated before such agents are used in human patients.

AI.tldr: hERG激活剂ICA-105574在10 mg/kg时显著缩短QT间期，30 mg/kg时全部豚鼠发生心脏停搏，提示其具有严重致心律失常风险。
AI.motivation: hERG1功能获得性突变导致短QT综合征，增加致死性心律失常风险，因此hERG/IKr激活剂作为候选药物可能具有类似的致心律失常风险，但相关在体证据缺乏。
AI.method: 采用异氟烷麻醉豚鼠模型，给予hERG激活剂ICA-105574（10和30 mg/kg），观察心电图变化；并测试hERG抑制剂E-4031（0.15 mg/kg）对30 mg/kg ICA-105574诱导心脏停搏的预防作用。
AI.result: 10 mg/kg ICA-105574组出现显著QT缩短，其最大作用时游离血浆浓度0.54 µM，与膜片钳研究中hERG激活的半数有效浓度0.49 µM相当；30 mg/kg组全部动物发生心脏停搏；预先给予0.15 mg/kg E-4031可预防30 mg/kg ICA-105574诱导的心脏停搏。
AI.conclusion: ICA-105574增加IKr可导致心脏停搏，表明hERG激活剂具有严重致心律失常风险；在开发此类候选药物时，必须在人体使用前全面评估致心律失常风险。

summary_zh: 人类ether-à-go-go相关基因1（hERG1）编码电压依赖性K+通道的孔道亚基，该通道介导快速延迟整流K+电流（IKr）。由于携带hERG1功能获得性突变的短QT综合征（SQTS）患者发生致死性心律失常的风险升高，激活hERG/IKr通道的小分子化合物也可能带来类似的心律失常风险。为了研究hERG激活剂相关的致心律失常风险，我们在异氟烷麻醉的豚鼠模型中检查了给予ICA-105574后的心电图（ECG）变化，已有报道显示ICA-105574可增加豚鼠心肌细胞的IKr。在10 mg/kg ICA-105574组中，观察到包括显著QT缩短在内的ECG改变。同时，所有接受30 mg/kg ICA-105574治疗的动物均出现心脏停搏。10 mg/kg ICA-105574在最大作用点时的估计游离血浆浓度为0.54 µM，与膜片钳研究中ICA-105574激活hERG的半数最大有效浓度（0.49 µM）相当。此外，0.15 mg/kg E-4031（一种选择性hERG抑制剂）可预防30 mg/kg ICA-105574诱导的心脏停搏。这些发现提示，ICA-105574引起的IKr增加导致心脏停搏。我们的数据表明，ICA-105574具有严重的致心律失常风险，包括心脏停搏。为了将ICA-105574和其他hERG激活化合物开发为候选治疗药物，必须在此类药物用于人类患者之前全面评估其致心律失常风险。
